blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 1.56 million minimum wage earners in Calabarzon will receive daily pay increases under a new wage order approved by the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board IV-A (RTWPB IV-A). The wage order provides daily increases ranging from P25 to P45, depending on the worker’s sector and the classification of the city or municipality where they are employed.
